breakdown.description: An n-type semiconductor with large donor density should have electrons as the majority carriers, not holes.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still references and works with the incorrect carrier concentrations (n and p) by instructing comparisons between them and N_D. The ground truth removes these erroneous values entirely and asks for a qualitative assessment from first principles. Instead of correcting the error (i.e., recognizing that in an n-type semiconductor electrons are the majority carriers), the generated specification merely asks the agent to 'identify inconsistencies,' implicitly preserving the flawed data rather than discarding it as the ground truth does.
